lines: (a) With KOH the products are water and potassium sulfate. Potassium sulfate is soluble, so it dissolves and its ions are free to move and carry the current.

(b) In both dilute acids, Cl- is at low concentration so OH- from water is discharged at the anode instead (sulfate is never discharged), so oxygen is given off in both: 4OH- -> O2 + 2H2O + 4e-.
At the cathode 2H+ + 2e- -> H2, so the same 4 electrons give 2 H2 for every 1 O2.
At the same temperature and pressure the volume ratio equals the mole ratio, 2 : 1.
